Senses.Explanation: At the point of words and phrases marks the very place where speech is being made, rather than a truth set apart from language. Yuanwu’s Blue Cliff Record and Tianqi’s notes preserve the line: “The Way has no difficulty; at the point of words and phrases, one has many kinds, two have no two ways.” A lamp hall address says that in the cold of early spring one is directly at that point. The phrase keeps the reader at the concrete turn of speaking instead of turning the line into a claim about an ineffable realm.
